title: SEOUL NATIONAL UNIVERSITY DENTAL HOSPITAL ESTABLISHMENT ACT
full_text:
SEOUL NATIONAL UNIVERSITY DENTAL HOSPITAL ESTABLISHMENT ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to promote the development of dentistry and contribute to improving the oral health of the people by establishing Seoul National University Dental Hospital to provide education, conduct research, and deliver medical services in dentistry.

Article 2 (Legal Personality)
Seoul National University Dental Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "Dental Hospital") shall be a corporation.

Article 3 (Establishment)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall be established upon registration of its establishment at the location of its principal office.
(2) Where necessary, the Dental Hospital may establish branch hospitals as prescribed by its articles of association.
(3) Matters necessary for registration of establishment under paragraph (1) and other registrations shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 4 (Articles of Association)
(1) The articles of association of the Dental Hospital shall include the following matters:
1. Its purpose;
2. Its name;
3. The location of its principal office;
4. Matters concerning its business;
5. Matters concerning education and research in dentistry;
6. Matters concerning the board of directors;
7. Matters concerning executive officers and employees;
8. Matters concerning its organization;
9. Matters concerning assets and accounting;
10. Matters concerning amendments to the articles of association;
11. Matters concerning public announcements;
12. Matters concerning dissolution.
(2) Amendments to the articles of association of the Dental Hospital shall require authorization from the Minister of Education. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 5 (Prohibition of Use of Similar Names)
No person other than the Dental Hospital under this Act shall use the name Seoul National University Dental Hospital or a similar name.

Article 6 (Business)
The Dental Hospital shall conduct the following business: <Amended on Jan. 7, 2014>
1. Clinical education for students in dentistry at Seoul National University, a national university corporation (hereinafter referred to as "Seoul National University");
2. Training of residents and medical personnel;
3. Research related to dentistry;
4. Clinical research;
5. Provision of medical services;
6. Public health and medical service projects under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Public Health and Medical Services Act;
7. Other business necessary to improve the oral health of the people.

Article 7 (Responsibilities as Public Health and Medical Institution)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall faithfully fulfill the obligations of public health and medical institutions under Article 7 of the Public Health and Medical Services Act.
(2) The Dental Hospital shall endeavor to improve public health by providing quality public health and medical services to the people.

Article 8 (Executive Officers)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall have nine directors, including a chairperson, and one auditor.
(2) The President of Seoul National University shall serve as the chairperson, and the directors shall comprise persons falling under the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as "ex officio directors") and persons appointed by the Minister of Education upon the recommendation of the board of directors. In such cases, the directors other than ex officio directors shall include at least one external person with extensive knowledge of and experience in hospital management: <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 7, 2014; Oct. 1, 2025>
1. The Vice Minister of Education, the Vice Minister of Health and Welfare (the Vice Minister of Health and Welfare designated by the Minister of Health and Welfare), and the Vice Minister of Planning and Budget;
2. The Director of the Dental Hospital, the Dean of the College of Dentistry of Seoul National University, and the Director of Seoul National University Hospital.
(3) The term of office of directors other than ex officio directors and of the auditor shall be three years, and each may be reappointed.
(4) The auditor shall audit the accounts and business of the Dental Hospital and shall be appointed by the Minister of Education upon the recommendation of the board of directors. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
(5) A person falling under any ground for disqualification in the subparagraphs of Article 33 of the State Public Officials Act shall not become a director other than an ex officio director, the auditor, or the Director of the Dental Hospital.
(6) Where a director other than an ex officio director, the auditor, or the Director of the Dental Hospital falls under any ground for disqualification in the subparagraphs of Article 33 of the State Public Officials Act, that person shall retire from office by operation of law.

Article 9 (Board of Directors)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall have a board of directors.
(2) The board of directors shall deliberate on the following matters: <Amended on Jan. 7, 2014>
1. Matters concerning amendments to the articles of association;
2. Matters concerning the organization;
3. Matters concerning business plans, budgets, and settlement of accounts;
4. Matters concerning the acquisition and disposal of property;
5. Matters concerning the formulation of public health and medical service plans under Article 8 of the Public Health and Medical Services Act and the results of their implementation;
6. Other matters deemed important and prescribed by the articles of association.
(3) The board of directors shall consist of the chairperson and directors.
(4) Matters necessary for the operation of the board of directors shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 10 (Director of Dental Hospital)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall have one Director of the Dental Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "Director").
(2) The Director shall represent the Dental Hospital and exercise overall control over its business.
(3) The Director shall be appointed by the President of the Republic of Korea upon the proposal of the Minister of Education following a recommendation by the board of directors. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
(4) The term of office of the Director shall be three years, and the Director may be reappointed only once.
(5) Where the Director is unable to perform duties due to an unavoidable reason, persons prescribed by Presidential Decree shall act on the Director's behalf in the order prescribed therein.
(6) The Director shall not be removed from office against their will during the term of office except in any of the following cases:
1. Where the Director violates this Act, an order issued under this Act, or the articles of association;
2. Where the Director impairs the operation of the Dental Hospital through accounting irregularities, willful misconduct, or gross negligence;
3. Where a physical or mental disability makes it extremely difficult or impossible for the Director to perform duties.
(7) To remove the Director from office pursuant to paragraph (6)1 through 3, a proposal for removal shall be made after a resolution approving removal is passed by at least two-thirds of the prescribed number of directors, including the chairperson.

Article 11 (Appointment and Dismissal of Employees)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall have the necessary medical personnel and employees.
(2) The appointment and dismissal of medical personnel and employees shall be governed by the articles of association.

Article 12 (Clinical Faculty Members)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall have clinical faculty members to conduct the business specified in the subparagraphs of Article 6.
(2) Article 16 of the Higher Education Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the titles and qualifications of clinical faculty members under paragraph (1).
(3) Where a clinical faculty member under paragraph (1) is appointed as a faculty member of a national school under Article 3 of the Higher Education Act, the period of service as a clinical faculty member at the Dental Hospital shall be deemed service as a faculty member of Seoul National University. <Amended on Jan. 7, 2014>
(4) Matters concerning the terms of appointment, appointment procedures, and remuneration of clinical faculty members shall be governed by the articles of association.

Article 13 (Concurrent Service)
(1) Where necessary for the Dental Hospital to conduct the business under Article 6, faculty members serving at Seoul National University may concurrently perform duties at the Dental Hospital. <Amended on Jan. 7, 2014>
(2) Concurrent service by faculty members under paragraph (1) shall be permitted by the President of Seoul National University at the request of the Director. <Amended on Jan. 7, 2014>
(3) Matters concerning the duties and remuneration of faculty members of Seoul National University who concurrently perform duties at the Dental Hospital pursuant to paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on Jan. 7, 2014>

Article 14 (Gratuitous Transfer of State Property)
Where necessary for the establishment and operation of the Dental Hospital, the Government may transfer or lend State property (including goods; hereinafter the same shall apply) to the Dental Hospital without consideration.

Article 15 (Contributions or Subsidies)
(1) The Government may make contributions for the basic facilities, equipment, and other requirements of the Dental Hospital.
(2) Expenses incurred in education and research in dentistry at the Dental Hospital shall be subsidized by the Government within budgetary limits.
(3) The Dental Hospital's operating expenses, expenses for facilities and equipment, and expenses for repaying the principal of and interest on loans shall be met from the Dental Hospital's revenues; provided, where those revenues are insufficient, the Government may provide subsidies.

Article 16 (Business Year)
The business year of the Dental Hospital shall correspond to the fiscal year of the Government.

Article 17 (Management of Accounts)
The Director shall manage the accounts of the Dental Hospital as prescribed by its articles of association.

Article 18 (Reporting of Business Plans)
The Director shall, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, prepare a business plan and budget for the Dental Hospital for each business year and report them to the Minister of Education no later than 20 days before the beginning of that business year. The same shall apply where the Director intends to amend them. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 19 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts)
The Director shall prepare a statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure accounts for each business year and submit it to the Minister of Education by the last day of February of the following year. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 20 (Supervision)
The Minister of Education shall supervise the Dental Hospital and may order the Director to report necessary matters or submit documents. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 21 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of Civil Act)
Except as provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated foundations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Dental Hospital.

Article 22 (Administrative Fines)
(1) A person who violates Article 5 shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding 5 million won. <Amended on Dec. 18, 2018>
(2) Administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Education as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>

ADDENDA <Act No. 6892, May 29, 2003>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date on which one year has elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Preparations for Establishment)
(1) The Minister of Education and Human Resources Development shall appoint not more than seven establishment commissioners within one year from the date of promulgation of this Act and have them handle matters concerning the establishment of the Dental Hospital.
(2) The establishment commissioners shall prepare the articles of association and obtain authorization from the Minister of Education and Human Resources Development.
(3) Where property is succeeded to without consideration pursuant to Article 3 of these Addenda for the establishment of the Dental Hospital, the establishment commissioners shall register its establishment and then hand over their affairs to the Director without delay.
(4) The establishment commissioners shall be deemed discharged upon completion of the handover of affairs under paragraph (3).

Article 3 (Gratuitous Succession to Property)
Property of Seoul National University Hospital that is being used by, or belongs to, its dental care division as of the date of establishment of the Dental Hospital shall be succeeded to by the Dental Hospital without consideration.

Article 4 (Succession to Claims and Obligations)
The Dental Hospital shall succeed to those claims and obligations of Seoul National University Hospital that pertain to its dental care division as of the date of establishment of the Dental Hospital.

Article 5 (Payment of Expenses)
(1) From the date of establishment of the Dental Hospital until its budget is finalized pursuant to this Act, the Director may pay necessary expenses from the budget allocated to the dental care division within the budget of Seoul National University Hospital for the relevant year, in accordance with the previous practice.
(2) When the budget of the Dental Hospital for the relevant year is established, expenses paid pursuant to paragraph (1) shall be deemed to have been executed under that budget.

Article 6 (Special Case concerning Appointment of Director)
Notwithstanding Article 9(3), the first Director under this Act shall be appointed by the President of the Republic of Korea upon the proposal of the Minister of Education and Human Resources Development following a recommendation by the President of Seoul National University.

Article 7 (Transitional Measures concerning Recognition of Service of Clinical Faculty Members)
Where a person serving as a clinical faculty member at the Dental Hospital as of the date of its establishment is appointed as an educational public official, Article 11(3) shall apply to the person's service as a clinical faculty member at Seoul National University Hospital before the date of establishment of the Dental Hospital.

Article 8 (Transitional Measures concerning Employees)
Faculty members holding concurrent positions, clinical faculty members, and employees serving in the dental care division of Seoul National University Hospital pursuant to Articles 10, 10-2, and 11 of the Seoul National University Hospital Establishment Act as of the date of establishment of the Dental Hospital shall be deemed appointed as faculty members holding concurrent positions, clinical faculty members, and employees of the Dental Hospital on that date.

Article 9 (Amendment of Other Acts)
The Seoul National University Hospital Establishment Act shall be amended as follows:

In Article 1 and Article 4(1)5, "medicine and dentistry" shall each be replaced by "medicine."

In Article 7(2), "Dean of the College of Dentistry" shall be replaced by "Director of Seoul National University Dental Hospital."
